title: Dissecting the StarLink: Characterizing Queuing and Flow Dynamics in the Starlink Network
authors: Hendrik Cech; Nitinder Mohan; Jörg Ott
affiliations: Technical University of Munich, Delft University of Technology
research_focus: Congestion control, RDMA / Transport, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Macro throughput/RTT statistics obscure bandwidth allocation, queue policy and periodic resets.
problem_statement.zh: macro throughput/RTT statistics 隱藏 bandwidth allocation、queue policy 與 periodic resets。

key_innovation.en: NetScalpel schedules synchronized UDP burst/rate/cooldown and TCP experiments around 15s cycles; reconstruct queues from paired timestamps and compare CCAs.
key_innovation.zh: NetScalpel 在 15s cycle 安排 synchronized UDP burst/rate/cooldown 與 TCP 實驗，以 paired timestamps 重建 queues 並比較 CCAs。

baselines_compared: BBRv1, BBRv3, CUBIC, SatPipe, HyStart, HyStart++, SEARCH, SUSS

key_improvements.en: Estimated queues ~1,500 DL/~4,000 UL packets; demand ramps 100/30Mbps baselines by3.4×/2× in400ms; bandwidth resets every15s; flow delay isolation coexists with coupled DL loss.
key_improvements.zh: estimated queues 約 DL1,500、UL4,000 packets；demand 使100/30Mbps baseline 在400ms增加3.4×/2×；bandwidth 每15s reset；flow delay isolation 與 coupled DL loss 並存。

evidence: §3 infrastructure; §4.1 queue; §4.2 capacity; §4.4 reset; §4.6 transport; PDF pp.2–12

scope.en: Observations describe Starlink implementation and measured terminals. Inter-satellite paths and internal operator state require further observability; demand-driven replay should preserve traffic dependence.
scope.zh: 觀察描述 Starlink implementation 與量測 terminals。inter-satellite path 和 operator state 需要更多 observability；demand-driven replay 應保留 traffic dependence。

model.en: Event-based head-drop queue reconstruction, demand-dependent capacity ramp model, paired Wilcoxon tests and equivalence testing.
model.zh: event-based head-drop queue reconstruction、demand-dependent capacity ramp model、paired Wilcoxon 與 equivalence testing。

evaluation.en: Munich residential terminal plus US east/west validation; AWS Frankfurt near PoP; NTP-calibrated microsecond packet records and 5ms TCP_INFO; randomized experiments across reconfiguration intervals.
evaluation.zh: Munich residential terminal 與 US east/west 驗證；AWS Frankfurt 鄰近 PoP；NTP 校準 microsecond packet records 與 5ms TCP_INFO；跨 reconfiguration intervals randomize experiments。
